instructions: Add one confirmed row per concrete evidence item. Cite canonical source files, copy verifier excerpts verbatim, and judge source presence separately from recovery.

criteria.criterion: Access the specified WoRMS taxon record (AphiaID 137106)
criteria.description: Attempt to open the WoRMS taxdetails page for AphiaID 137106 and base the answer on that record. Full credit if the agent attempts access but WoRMS is unavailable/blocked (e.g., downtime/captcha) and the agent clearly reports that it cannot retrieve the record contents. Partial credit if WoRMS is used but the record identity (AphiaID) is ambiguous. No credit if information is clearly taken from a different AphiaID/record or another site without indicating inability to access WoRMS.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 explicitly shows the WoRMS “taxon details” page with the details table including “AphiaID 137106”. Screenshot 2 (later) shows the taxonomic citation with the URL containing id=137106, further confirming the correct record was accessed.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent was on the specified WoRMS taxdetails record for AphiaID 137106, so the baseline should be raised to full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the WoRMS (World Register of Marine Species) site with the page section titled “WoRMS taxon details”. The taxon displayed is “Stenella clymene (Gray, 1850)”. In the details table, a line reads “AphiaID 137106 (urn:lsid:marinespecies.org:taxname:137106)”.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: This is clearly the WoRMS taxdetails record for AphiaID 137106, and the screenshot displays the AphiaID explicitly. Criterion satisfied.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No discrepancy: the screenshot matches the specified AphiaID 137106 WoRMS taxon details page.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows a WoRMS taxon record page section with headings and tabs. Visible elements include: a line reading “Taxonomic citation” followed by: “Fordyce, E.; Perrin, W.F. (2026). World Cetacea Database. Stenella clymene (Gray, 1850). Accessed through: World Register of Marine Species at: https://www.marinespecies.org/aphia.php?p=taxdetails&id=137106 on 2026-09-09”. Below that is “Taxonomic edit history” with a table showing dates and actions: “2004-12-21 15:54:05Z created” by “van der Land, Jacob” and “2008-08-20 11:25:36Z checked” by “Perrin, William”. A “Licensing” line indicates the page text is under “Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License”. A row of tabs is visible: “Sources (11)”, “Documented distribution (4)”, “Notes (5)”, “Attributes (15)”, “Vernaculars (21)”, “Links (15)”, “Images (3)”. The visible content area is on the “Sources” tab showing sections “NOMENCLATURE”, “ECOLOGY”, and “OTHER” with bibliographic references. The screenshot does NOT show the Classification box, AphiaID field, taxonomic status field, or any environment indicators (e.g., marine/brackish/freshwater/terrestrial) in this view.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Criterion 0 requires accessing the specified WoRMS taxdetails record for AphiaID 137106. The screenshot provides strong evidence that the page is indeed the WoRMS taxdetails record for id=137106 because the “Taxonomic citation” line explicitly includes the URL with “p=taxdetails&id=137106” and references the species name “Stenella clymene (Gray, 1850)”. This supports that the agent accessed the correct record page. However, the screenshot does not itself display the AphiaID label/value or other identity/status fields—only the citation containing the URL with the id parameter.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The agent’s predicted output lists AphiaID, taxonomic status, genus/family, and environment states. None of those specific fields (AphiaID label, status, classification genus/family, or environment with struck-through/affirmed text) are visible in this screenshot. The only directly supported pieces from the screenshot are the scientific name with authority (“Stenella clymene (Gray, 1850)”) and that the accessed URL includes “id=137106”. Therefore, most of the predicted output is not verifiable from this screenshot alone (though not directly contradicted).

criteria.criterion: Report identity fields: AphiaID and scientific name with authority (from the main record header)
criteria.description: Extract and report the AphiaID and the scientific name exactly as displayed on the AphiaID 137106 record, including authority. Full credit if both are correct and taken from the main record (not a synonym row). Partial credit if one field is correct or the authority is missing but the main name is otherwise correct. Full credit may also be awarded if the agent cannot access the page but explicitly states it cannot retrieve these fields due to site access issues (rather than guessing). No credit if the scientific name is taken from a synonym/unaccepted-name listing while presented as the record’s own displayed scientific name.

criteria.criterion: Report taxonomic status from the record (without substituting synonyms)
criteria.description: Report the taxonomic status exactly as shown on the AphiaID 137106 record (e.g., accepted/unaccepted/alternate representation). Full credit for exact or clearly equivalent wording that matches the record, and for not replacing the record’s name/status with a synonym’s. Partial credit if the status is directionally correct but wording is slightly off. Full credit may also be awarded if the agent cannot access the page but clearly reports inability to verify the status due to access issues. No credit if the status is fabricated or derived from synonym information while treating it as the main record status.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows the row “Status” with value “accepted”.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent reported the taxonomic status as accepted, which matches the record. Full credit.

evidence_analyses.discrepancies: None; status is correctly read from the main record area.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 0 shows the dedicated `Status` field with value `accepted`.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Agent reported taxonomic status as accepted, which is explicitly supported by the record’s Status field. Full credit.

evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:

criteria.criterion: Report displayed environment states (affirmed vs struck-through)
criteria.description: List the environment labels shown on the record and separate which are affirmed (normal text) versus struck through, preserving that distinction exactly as displayed. Full credit if the affirmed vs struck-through separation matches the record. Partial credit if environments are listed but the strike-through state is incomplete/mixed. Full credit may also be awarded if the agent cannot view the environment display due to access/rendering issues and clearly reports this (rather than guessing). No credit if environment information is omitted without explanation or if the affirmed/struck-through distinction is not attempted.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows the Environment line with “marine” in normal (affirmed) text and “terrestrial” struck through.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The output preserves the affirmed vs struck-through distinction exactly as displayed (marine affirmed; terrestrial struck through). Full credit.

evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The predicted output separates affirmed vs struck-through environments as “marine” affirmed and “terrestrial” struck through, matching what is visible. Criterion satisfied.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: None; the struck-through vs normal distinction matches the screenshot display.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 1 (latest) shows Environment containing only `~~terrestrial~~` (struck through). DOM-model state 0 (earlier) shows `Environment: marine, ~~terrestrial~~`, indicating marine affirmed and terrestrial struck through in that earlier view.

The agent’s additional claim that `marine` is affirmed is not confirmed by the latest evidence (though it appears in an earlier state). Award partial credit for correctly capturing the struck-through environment while over-claiming the affirmed one.
